name: Uday Pratap Singh Parihar
headline: Full Stack Developer · Next.js / React Native
summary: Full-stack developer focused on **shipping production features** across **web and mobile**, and building efficient automation systems. Hands-on experience building **LLM-powered products**, developing **agentic workflows**, and **reverse-engineering complex APIs** to solve integration challenges. Comfortable with **high-throughput systems** and building reliable tools where documentation is limited. I dig into how systems work to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
